videos.title: Is it accredited? Straight answers.
videos.meta: P4 · 40–45 s · **Kuwait wording approved by HR, word for word**
videos.vo:

Saint Mary's University of Minnesota is accredited by the Higher Learning Commission in the United States.
For expatriate teachers: Acceptance of its MAED and Ed.D. qualifications for employment in Kuwait is subject to the relevant authorities' requirements and approval of the individual application.
For Kuwaiti citizens: Prospective Kuwaiti applicants should obtain confirmation from the Ministry of Higher Education and their employer regarding degree equivalency and eligibility for any salary or career benefits before enrolling.
Questions? Ask us anything.

carousels.title: Myths vs facts: a master's while teaching
slides: **MYTHS VS FACTS** · Doing a master's while teaching full-time
**Myth:** "I don't have time." · **Fact:** It's designed around a teaching week — weekly classes, 18 months.
**Myth:** "It's too expensive." · **Fact:** From 222.22 KD/month for ACA staff, plus PL stipend support.
**Myth:** "I'll be on my own." · **Fact:** You study in a cohort — often with colleagues you already know.
**Myth:** "I'd have to quit my job." · **Fact:** Our students keep teaching the whole way through.
**Myth:** "Online means a different degree." · **Fact:** The online option leads to the same degree and diploma.
**Ready for the facts in person?** Ask us anything · pli@aca.edu.kw

carousels.title: 5 signs you're ready for your master's
slides: **5 SIGNS YOU'RE READY FOR YOUR MASTER'S**
**1.** You've said "one day" more than once this year.
**2.** Colleagues come to you for ideas.
**3.** You want a bigger voice in curriculum decisions.
**4.** You can see yourself leading a team.
**5.** You have a PL stipend waiting to be used. (ACA staff)
**3 out of 5? It's time.** {{APPLY_LINK}}

carousels.title: Your 2027 growth plan
slides: **YOUR 2027 GROWTH PLAN** · in 4 steps
**1. Name one skill** you want to master this year.
**2. Find your people** — learning sticks better in a cohort.
**3. Make it monthly** — big goals feel lighter in small steps.
**4. Put a date on it** — cohorts start on 4 January and 15 March.
**New year. Next degree.** {{APPLY_LINK}}

linkedin.title: The staff-room secret
linkedin.text:
When people ask me who joins our Master of Arts in Education, I give an answer that surprises them.

More than 6 in 10 of our past students were ACA educators.

They taught full days. They planned, marked, ran clubs and parent meetings. And every week, they came to class to work toward a Saint Mary's University of Minnesota degree.

That tells me two things. First, the programme works around a real teaching schedule. Second, the best advertisement for professional learning is a colleague who has done it.

If you've been thinking about a master's, ask someone in your staff room who has done it. Then ask me anything.

Our January 2027 cohort is open → {{APPLY_LINK}}

#ProfessionalLearning #MAEd #TeachersOfKuwait

linkedin.title: What I learned from our cohorts
linkedin.text:
Three things I've learned from coordinating our MAED cohorts:

1. Nobody feels "ready". The educators who finish are the ones who start anyway.
2. The cohort is the curriculum too. Teachers from Canada, the US, the UK, South Africa, Lebanon, Jordan, Tunisia and Kuwait learn as much from each other as from the course.
3. Small, monthly steps beat one big leap. Eighteen months goes faster than you think.

If one of these sounds like you, our next cohort starts on 15 March.
→ {{APPLY_LINK}}

linkedin.title: Why we price it monthly
linkedin.text:
The first question every teacher asks me is "How much?"

So we made the answer simple. The MAED is 4,000 KD for ACA staff, paid as 222.22 KD a month over 18 months. For external educators it's 4,200 KD, or 233.33 KD a month. ACA staff can also apply their PL stipend and signing bonus.

No lump sum. No surprises. One month at a time.

If cost has been the thing holding you back, let's sit down and map out your plan.
→ pli@aca.edu.kw

linkedin.title: For school leaders: grow your team
linkedin.text:
A note to principals and heads of department:

Some of the strongest teachers in your building have probably told you they want to "do a master's one day".

You can make "one day" this year. Mention the MAED in your next team meeting. Share this post with the colleague you think is ready. More than 6 in 10 of our past students were ACA educators — and many started because a leader encouraged them.

For leaders with 10+ years of experience, our Executive Leadership Doctorate is also open.
→ {{APPLY_LINK}}

linkedin.title: Ask me anything about the Ed.D
linkedin.text:
I'm often asked whether a doctorate is realistic for a working school leader.

Our Executive Leadership Doctorate with Saint Mary's University of Minnesota is 39 credits over three years, fully online with a local Kuwait cohort, and has no dissertation. It's designed for professionals with 10 or more years of leadership experience.

This week I'm keeping my calendar open for 15-minute conversations with leaders who want to explore it. Comment or message me.

emails.subject: Grow where you teach: January MAED cohort is open
emails.body:
Dear colleagues,

Did you know that more than 6 in 10 of our past Master of Arts in Education students were ACA educators?

Our next Saint Mary's University of Minnesota MAED cohort starts in January. It's 30 credits over 18 months, with weekly in-person classes here in Kuwait, and two tracks: Curriculum & Instruction or Educational Leadership.

As ACA staff you receive the staff rate of 4,000 KD (222.22 KD/month over 18 months), and you can apply your PL stipend and signing bonus toward tuition.

Book a 15-minute chat: {{APPLY_LINK}} or reply to this email.

Warm regards,
Salwa Sleiman · Professional Learning Institute Coordinator
